title: 太空制药：产量提升十倍，居家注射能否实现？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Energy in space to medicine in space UK startup bio orbit is making a bold bet that by sending drug making towards the stars it can help save
segments.zh: 从太空能源到太空医药，英国初创公司BioOrbit大胆押注：将药物制造送入星空，有助于拯救生命并节省数十亿美元。

segments.en: Lives and billions of dollars, potentially from health providers like the NHS and potentially pave the way for novel cancer treatments that are easier to use
segments.zh: 可能为NHS等医疗系统节省开支，并为更易使用的新型癌症疗法铺平道路。

segments.en: The company has a lofty goal. It wants to harness weightlessness or microgravity to produce protein crystals that could pave the way for cancer treatments
segments.zh: 该公司目标远大：利用失重或微重力环境生产蛋白质晶体，为癌症治疗开辟新途径。

segments.en: that people can inject at home instead of receiving by IV. In March, bio orbit orbit won a 250,000-pound contract from the UK Space Agency to develop the technology Katie King, bio orbit's co-founder and CEO is with me now in the studio Katie.
segments.zh: 患者可在家自行注射，无需静脉输液。三月，BioOrbit赢得英国航天局25万英镑合同，开发该技术。联合创始人兼CEO凯蒂·金来到演播室。

segments.en: Thank you for coming in. When I was talking to people about what you do, people who are not in your sector, excuse the pun, there was going to be a problem. Wow, that sounds like science fiction, but you have come through with a really important proof point
segments.zh: 感谢到来。当我和非业内人士聊起你们的工作时，他们觉得这像科幻小说。但你们最近取得了重要的验证成果。

segments.en: Just in the last few months talk us about the progress that you and the team have made. It's a really exciting time for bio orbit. We just launched a record breaking mission to the space station producing the largest scale production of protein crystals in a space environment
segments.zh: 谈谈你们取得的进展。这对BioOrbit来说是激动人心的时刻。我们刚刚完成了一项创纪录的任务，在国际空间站上大规模生产蛋白质晶体。

segments.en: By one order, if not two orders of magnitude, and this is a necessary stepping stone towards taking those cancer treatments and enabling them to be self-administered at home
segments.zh: 产量提升了一个甚至两个数量级，这是实现癌症治疗药物在家自行给药的关键一步。

segments.en: Why is this so important and what can space allow you to do that we can't do back on Earth?
segments.zh: 为什么这如此重要？太空能实现哪些地球上无法做到的事情？
